about: What the installer says about the app. installer/build-installer.mjs passes these to installer/setup/streams.iss and, with rcedit, into Streams.exe's version info. app_guid is the Windows uninstall entry's identity ({app_guid}_is1 under HKCU): never change it, or an update installs beside the old copy. copyright is the one copyright line of both version infos (Streams.exe's LegalCopyright and the setup program's VersionInfoCopyright). The AppUserModelID is not here: it is desktop/src/main/app-id.mjs, which the app itself reads. `version` is major.minor.patch, digits only (desktop/src/main/version.mjs VERSION_RE: what the app shows and the update compares); `pre_release` names the development round before 1.0.0 ships (1.0.0-dev.0) and goes into app_ver_name only.
